Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a concise retrospective note for EXP-2023-05-expansion-nudge recording its final status, measured result, rollout decision, and useful direction for later Expansion Assist work.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "EXP-2023-05-expansion-nudge — retrospective — 2028-01-01", "body": "EXP-2023-05-expansion-nudge — final retrospective

Date: 2028-01-01

Final status: Inconclusive (landed 2023-06-29).

Measured result: The mature aggregate read was approximately +$6.20 expansion MRR per account versus control (n=392, p=0.16), below the predeclared +$8 bar. The signal was concentrated among accounts with 3+ integrations, at least 2 active admins, and signs of a usage ceiling; low-depth accounts were nearly flat.

Rollout decision: Do not roll out or widen the blanket day-60 nudge. The prior flag was rolled back to 0%; lingering exposure must not be treated as rollout momentum, Expansion Assist validation, pipeline credit, or forecast/revenue impact.

Direction for later Expansion Assist work: Treat this as a targeting hypothesis, not a broad win. Continue exploratory, behavior-based work for upgrade-ready retained-mid accounts, anchored on integration depth, active-admin behavior, and usage-ceiling signals. Define when a prompt appears, is suppressed, or hands off to Sales/Customer Success; keep product-visible usage-ceiling data directional until its measurement is mature.
